verdict.rationale: DBOS ships first-party integrations for the OpenAI Agents SDK, where DBOSRunner.run is a drop-in replacement for Runner.run, and for the Vercel AI SDK, where completed agent steps replay from checkpoints after a crash. That delivers durability for these frameworks with essentially no glue code. Coverage is limited to these two documented integrations, and other agents still need manual workflow/step annotations, though this is only a small change (<20 lines). Missing for 10: evidence of integrations for other agent frameworks and direct model-provider SDKs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the integrations.
